provenance.description_ja: 今回新たに列挙して検証した固定5質問の構成です。過去の保存資料から復元した固定質問案ではありません。
provenance.construction: 11 distinct 5-bit codewords; all 55 coordinatewise integer sums of two different codewords are distinct. Each question is selected by one bit position, least significant bit first.

signature_rule: For question k, count members in the fixed selected set. Pair signatures are coordinatewise integer sums, not bitwise OR.

guarantee.basis: Exhaustive per-capacity signature uniqueness plus the independently verified 216-pattern mean-score encoding; the 2,494,800 joint placements are covered compositionally, not replayed one by one.
